source_caption:
🎥🎬: Adventure Time (2010–2018)

Finn, a fearless human boy, and his magical shape-shifting dog Jake explore the strange and colorful Land of Ooo. Together, they battle monsters, help kingdoms, and get caught up in bizarre adventures alongside Princess Bubblegum, Marceline, the Ice King, and countless other unforgettable characters.

What begins as simple heroic quests gradually becomes a much deeper journey about friendship, growing up, love, loss, and the mysterious history of Ooo. As Finn and Jake face increasingly powerful threats, they discover that their world holds secrets far bigger than they ever imagined.

source_details.title: Adventure Time
source_details.synopsis: Adventure Time is an American animated fantasy television series created by Pendleton Ward for Cartoon Network. It follows the adventures of a boy named Finn (Jeremy Shada) and his best friend and adoptive brother Jake (John DiMaggio)—a dog with the power to change size and shape at will. Finn and Jake live in the post-apocalyptic Land of Ooo, where they interact with Princess Bubblegum (Hynden Walch), the Ice King (Tom Kenny), Marceline the Vampire Queen (Olivia Olson), BMO (Niki Yang), and others.
